meta.title: An empty token is refused
gaps: act 1: cannot be executed — the buyer's web-console session may not call GET /v1/attachments/open (attachments#open is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml); such a call is answered 401 and signs the session out

verify 1: cannot be executed — the buyer's web-console session may not call GET /v1/attachments/open (attachments#open is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml); such a call is answered 401 and signs the session out

GET /v1/attachments/open?token= cannot be executed by the available buyer or vendor sessions because the endpoint is not permitted for the web-console app and returns 401 while signing the session out
The HTTP 422 response with plain-text 'Invalid token' cannot be checked
The absence of a redirect cannot be checked
